subject: Launch runbook — scheduling final cutover + backout owners
messages:
From: Samir Kulkarni <samir.kulkarni@brightpathhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@brightpathhealth.com, Elena Torres <elena.torres@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Scheduling final launch runbook discussion

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to lock down the final launch runbook and owners for cutover/backout. Procurement will need ~30 mins to confirm licensing on the call. Security wants to review the fallback controls.

Our core asks:
- Confirm owners for each cutover stage (DB migration, traffic flip, post-checks).
- Agree on a firm time for the final run-through and a backout window.
- Provide the rollback checklist ahead of the call so our SREs can review.

Available windows (PST): Tue 11/24 afternoon 2–4pm, Thu 11/26 10–12p, Mon 11/30 morning 9–11am.

Attaching our internal checklist for reference (see stub).

Attachments: brightpath-prelaunch-notes.pdf (attachment stub)

Best,
Samir
Engineering Manager — BrightPath Health
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kulkarni <samir.kulkarni@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: aisha_rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, procure@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling final launch runbook discussion

Samir — thanks. I suggest we do a dedicated 90-minute run-through: 60m for step-by-step cutover and 30m for contingency/backout and Q&A.

Proposed owners from our side (tentative):
- Traffic flip / routing: Dev Patel (SE)
- KV/cache warmup and validation: Dev Patel
- DB schema & migrations (coordination only): Aisha Rahman (AE) to work with your SREs
- Rollback coordination & communications: Tessa Morgan (PM lead)
- Security sign-off on controls: Hannah Schmitt

Proposed times (PST):
- Mon 11/30 09:00–10:30 (preferred)
- Thu 11/26 10:30–12:00 (alternate)

I'll attach our internal cutover_checklist.xlsx and a lightweight fallback_runbook.md for you to review ahead of time. Procurement, can you confirm whether 30 minutes at the start is enough for licensing sign-off?

Attachments: cutover_checklist.xlsx (attachment stub), fallback_runbook.md (attachment stub)

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Program Manager, Customer Launches
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@brightpathhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Samir Kulkarni <samir.kulkarni@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: procure@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling final launch runbook discussion

Hi all — heads up, security is blocked for the 11/26 window due to a compliance review. Can we avoid Thanksgiving week slots for full stakeholders?

If 11/30 is possible, please confirm call length and whether we can get the fallback_runbook.md at least 48 hours prior so our security SME can triage. Also please include the emergency contact/phone bridge in the invite.

Thanks,
Elena
Senior Security Engineer — BrightPath Health
From: aisha_rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@brightpathhealth.com>, Samir Kulkarni <samir.kulkarni@brightpathhealth.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, procure@brightpathhealth.com, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling final launch runbook discussion

All — 11/30 09:00–10:30 PST works for our team.

Finalized agenda (60m run-through + 30m contingency):
1) 09:00–09:10 — Introductions & scope (AE + PM) — Aisha
2) 09:10–09:35 — Cutover steps / traffic flip (SE lead) — Dev
3) 09:35–09:50 — Post-cutover validation checks (SRE + customer) — Samir
4) 09:50–10:10 — Security controls & monitoring (Security lead) — Hannah & Elena
5) 10:10–10:25 — Backout / rollback playbook review (communications & owners) — Tessa
6) 10:25–10:30 — Action items & next steps — Aisha

Owners and explicit fallback contacts: 
- DB migration coordinator: Samir Kulkarni (customer) / fallback: Markus Klein (Redwood Engineering Manager)
- Traffic flip & routing owner: Dev Patel / fallback: Aisha Rahman
- Post-check validation owner: Samir / fallback: Dev Patel
- Security sign-off: Elena / fallback: Hannah Schmitt
- Communications & external comms: Tessa / fallback: Markus Klein

Attachments: rollback_playbook.pdf (attachment stub)

A couple of quick asks before the call:
- Samir: can you provide the on-call phone numbers for your SRE team?
- Procurement: please confirm the first 30 minutes for licensing is sufficient.

Thanks — see you on 11/30.
Aisha
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Samir Kulkarni <samir.kulkarni@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, procure@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 01:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling final launch runbook discussion

Quick technical note — I recommend we treat the first 20 minutes as a dry-run of the traffic flip (internal-only steps) to verify scripts and KV warming. Then we can bring the customer in for validation checks. That means the 90-minute slot is tight but workable.

I'll prepare the runbook snippets I’ll read during the flip and post a short checklist into the Jira ticket (INF-2110). Also adding a 24-hour rollback timer in the playbook so everyone knows the measured observation window after flip.

Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2110

Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kulkarni <samir.kulkarni@brightpathhealth.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@brightpathhealth.com>, aisha_rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, procure@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 17:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling final launch runbook discussion

All — confirmed 11/30 09:00–10:30 PST. I've sent the calendar-invite (calendar-invite.ics) with the bridge and emergency contact numbers.

Action items before the call:
- Samir: share SRE on-call numbers and any maintenance blackout windows (due 11/29 EOD).
- Elena & Hannah: please review fallback_runbook.md and confirm any monitoring gaps (due 11/29 EOD).
- Dev: post the dry-run checklist to INF-2110 (done by 11/29 noon).
- Procurement: confirm licensing sign-off can be done in the first 30 minutes.

If there are last-minute conflicts, reply-all with the specific time conflict and we'll try to swap with the 11/30 afternoon slot (13:00–14:30 PST) as backup.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth run.

--
Tessa Morgan
Program Manager, Customer Launches
Redwood Inference
